audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Singed levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, but the whys under those same rows say Karma 'leads the window', 'retains the edge', and that the two-item state is 'split but lean toward Skill'. The chart and the prose describe opposite lanes.
audit.why: Karma is a ranged lane bully into a melee juggernaut with no dash. Inner Flame reaches 950 units; Poison Trail is a 20-unit aura around Singed. She is never forced to walk into range, so no stage before her Mantra is spent belongs to Singed. Singed's 51.7% comes from proxy macro, not from winning laning stages.
audit.corrected: Karma / Karma / Karma / Karma / Skill / Karma / Skill — matching the whys already written and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid-game text states 'At level 6 she gets Mantra on her R'. Karma has Mantra from level 1 and it costs no skill point.
audit.why: Riot's own Mantra description: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.' Cooldown 40/38/36/34, and Gathering Fire reduces it on every damaging ability. A Singed player told to wait for level 6 will walk into a Mantra-Q at level 2.
audit.corrected: Mantra is live from level 1 on a 40s cooldown falling to 34s, shortened further by Gathering Fire. The real level-6 spike is Singed's: Insanity Potion (100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which is the first thing in the matchup that cuts her Renewal heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive kit interaction is never stated: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is applied by Poison Trail, so Singed's ult is the direct answer to Mantra-W Renewal. whys[4] instead claims Renewal 'counters attrition'.
audit.why: Singed R flag antiHeal: 'applies healing reduction', delivered through Poison Trail rather than an on-hit. Karma's only sustain in lane is the Mantra-W heal. Also: Mega Adhesive's grounding is near-worthless here — Karma has no dash — so its value is the slow plus the Fling-into-glue root, and Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank, which is the single number the lane is played around.
audit.corrected: State the Grievous Wounds counter to Renewal, and gate every run-past on the flat 12s Focused Resolve rather than on a vague 'cooldown'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every reference is to 'Focused Resolve's cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5, Mantra 40/38/36/34. Those are the three gates.
audit.corrected: Concrete numbers added to mid, tldr and the first-item phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing notes that Focused Resolve is a tether that breaks on distance or line of sight — it is mentioned in the full layer's cooldown block but never turned into an action.
audit.why: Singed's entire pattern is running away, which is the natural tether-break. This is a mechanical gift the page does not hand the player.
audit.corrected: Left to the existing cooldown block this pass; flagged rather than force-fitted into a length-locked field.

edits.before: At level 6 she gets Mantra on her R, which supercharges either Soulflare (big root AoE burst) or Renewal (massive shield and heal). Neither lets you trade cleanly. Play your lane around her Mantra charge: when she just spent it you have a brief window to run a poison pass, and if she steps into Mega Adhesive you can W-root, E-fling, keep her in cloud. The moment Rylai's Crystal Scepter finishes, your pattern finally sticks — slow chains mean she cannot simply E-kite out of your cloud anymore, and that is your first real leverage in this lane. Before that item, proxy and proxy again.
edits.after: Mantra is not a level-6 unlock — she has had it since level 1, on 40s falling to 34s, and Gathering Fire shortens it every time she lands a damaging spell. Count it anyway: the pass right after she spends Mantra is the free one, and Focused Resolve's flat 12s is the second gate. Fling her into Mega Adhesive inside that window and the landing roots her in your cloud. The moment Rylai's Crystal Scepter finishes, your pattern sticks — she cannot Inspire-kite clear of the poison anymore, and that is your first real leverage. Before that item, proxy and proxy again.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's stat dump gives you the durability to attempt run-past patterns, but her Mantra-R (Soulflare root or Renewal shield) counters both all-in and attrition — call it genuinely even.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which finally cuts the Renewal heal that beat your attrition — but Soulflare's root still stops a run-past cold, so call level 6 genuinely even.

edits.before: Weather the poke — poison-kite him and fling the Focused Resolve commit. Singed wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — poison-kite her and fling the Focused Resolve commit. Singed wins the flat 12s Focused Resolve windows.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Inner Flame reaches 950 and your cloud is an aura — she never walks in. Proxy, don't hold.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where she is not. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds answers Renewal, so 6 evens out.
edits.note: Mantra is not new at 6; removed the implication.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Rylai's makes the cloud stick, but her 12s Focused Resolve still cancels a run-past — force right after she spends it.

notes: The full layer refers to Karma as 'him'/'he' throughout (tldr, winCon, enemyWin, phases, breakdown, dosFull, dontsFull, ahead, report). I fixed it only inside strings I was already rewriting; a champion-level gender pass is needed rather than 20 one-word edits per matchup. Also: the packet's levelChart for singed does not match what is on disk in either layer (disk content win[] and full phases[].side agree with each other, packet disagrees) — the packet appears to be stale or pre-corrected. I treated disk as the source for 'before' and used the packet chart only as corroboration.
